review_kind: Independent pre-run review of bounded post hoc pre-reset precision diagnostic
approval_scope: One pinned existing native 100pA/80-substeps trace and five predefined smooth no-reset variants over fixed0..858.4875ms; descriptive common-prethreshold telemetry only. Commit the diagnostic protocol, source and input checksum manifest before execution. No original primary criteria or model/backend changes.
verified_design: Original four native trace/sidecar files require exact manifest coverage and hashes, successful original exit and exact native metadata. Original preregistration manifest and all original source hashes are checked.

Native prefix ends at final pre-reset overshoot858.4875ms and excludes reset END858.5ms. Native reset validation uses the next row's end time with1e-10ms tolerance and checks Vmin, float32 u+=d and AP latch; detection-time label is distinct.

Standard float64 RK4 uses exact reciprocal, nominal timestep and one-sixth. Matched float64 jointly promotes GPU-rounded float32 reciprocal, timestep and one-sixth. Both integrate coupled voltage/recovery through all RK4 stages.
Explicit float32 RK4 rounds scalar arithmetic operations in pinned source order without FMA and is explicitly not asserted to equal compiled GPU arithmetic.

DOP853 integrates exact0/100ms phase transition with independently tightened tolerance/maxstep controls, dense output at full native substep times and same actual float32 initialstate/parameters/current promoted to float64.

First crossing brackets are computed separately for native and each variant; common telemetry ends at earliest bracket lower endpoint. Saved extensions beyond individual threshold crossings are explicitly not treated as faithful reset-model trajectories.
Component maximum/RMS/endpoint differences, first1e-5 exceedance and predefined checkpoints are descriptive telemetry, not replacement numerical acceptance criteria or biological tolerance.
No reset implementation, GPU rerun, biological scoring, parameter fitting, current fitting or variant selection is added.

Final source explicitly reports each float64 RK4 versus tight DOP853 using the same common-prethreshold mask, and flags reference reliability only when BOTH component DOP refinement maxima are at most1e-7. Protocol matches code and limits attribution when that flag fails.
generic_test_evidence: Imported through pinned environment; generic telemetry and crossing-bracket tests plus two-step non-CA2 equilibrium arithmetic tests for standard/matched float64 and explicit float32 passed. No CA2 or DOP853 integration executed in review.
resolved_draft_issues: Reset boundary now distinguishes previous overshoot/detection row from next reset-end row rather than comparing wrong row or exact decimal timestamps.

interpretation_limits: This is authorized post hoc engineering evidence for a selected condition, not a new population biological validation or a repair of original failed gates.
Matched coefficient variant changes three constants jointly; its contrast is joint coefficient sensitivity rather than isolation of one constant.
Explicit non-FMA float32 arithmetic may differ from GPU compiler fusion/rounding, so matching or mismatch cannot alone prove exact GPU implementation equivalence.
Crossing interpolation is a bracketed descriptive estimate. Common telemetry remains confined to sampled states before the earliest crossing bracket.
final_scoped_rereview: Two explicit RK4/reference telemetry records and attribution reliability flag added; arithmetic, integrations, native inputs, common stop and original criteria unchanged. AST syntax check passed; no new integrations.
